messages.en: What are you doing?
Gravity is out~
Zenith worked really hard choosing everything.
Do you like it?
What do you want to see?
Oho.
Oh, right.
I figured it's about time I started exercising again.
So the other day I dragged Soomin outside,
and we ran for three hours.
The funniest part was,
our running speeds were completely different.
I kept slowing down to match her pace,
so I barely got any exercise,
while Soomin was the only one getting exhausted.
So near the end,

messages.ko: 너때문에 내가 운동이 안되잖아 하면서 등밀어주면서 계속 뛰었는데
messages.en: I kept pushing her from behind, saying, "Because of you I'm not getting any exercise!" while we kept running.

messages.ko: 막판에 수민이가 자기 버리고 먼저 뛰라길래
messages.en: Then at the very end, Soomin told me to leave her behind and keep going.
So I said, "Do your best and catch up~"
I ran ahead, then looked back... and she was nowhere to be seen.
So I kept waiting,
and she came running like a puppy with an injured leg,
limping while trying her best to catch up,
she was yelling while running toward me.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋ
She was seriously so cute.

messages.ko: 옆에 러닝하시는 다른 사람들 다 쳐다보는데
messages.en: Everyone else who was out running kept staring at us,
but she didn't care at all.
she just kept shouting.
I thought I was going to die laughing.
Maybe they were staring because you two were so pretty?
We looked like absolute messes. ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
They were definitely looking at us weirdly.
Kim Soomin is seriously so funny.
Soomin has been bullying me lately.
She calls me every day,
and whenever I answer, "What is it?"

messages.ko: 내가 전화하는게 이유가 필요해????!!! 왜 왜라고 말하는거야 자꾸????
messages.en: she goes, "Do I need a reason to call you????!!! Why do you always ask 'why'????"

messages.ko: 근데 수민이 자기전에 리네랑 맨날 전화한데..
messages.en: But I heard Soomin calls Rinne every night before going to sleep...
Right, after hearing that,
now every time she calls,
I ask, "What number call am I today?"
That's what I ask her.
But are you Soomin's first call too?
I don't really make phone calls.
I don't usually contact people first
to begin with.
Lately,
I've been buying pretty new notebooks and mechanical pencils,
and at the dorm I've just been drawing and writing.
That's all I've been doing.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
That sounds like a whole concept...

messages.ko: 내 이미지가 워낙 웃기고 막 사랑스럽고 귀엽고 여신이라 그렇지
messages.en: It's only because my image is already funny, lovable, cute, and goddess-like.
But I'm actually quite sentimental too.

messages.ko: 내가 웨이브 생각하면서 구림 하나 그려서
messages.en: I drew something while thinking about WAV.
I'll send it to you later.
Draw poop.
Agh.
Talking about poop,
is it a cheat code no matter your age?
What kind of things are you writing? Like Chaewon's diss rap?
I do that normally.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Recently I've been writing something much deeper.
Things like human complacency and destiny.
That kind of theme.
It's not late puberty...
Please call it 'artist syndrome.'
하하.
If I were to reveal just one sentence...
it would be:

messages.ko: 그리움과 슬픔은 필연적이지만 죄책과 좌절은 운명과도 같다고 생각했다
messages.en: I thought longing and sadness were inevitable, but guilt and despair were something akin to fate.

messages.ko: 죄책과 후회 그리움이 섞여 내린 눈물은 아무맛이 나지 않을것이다
messages.en: Tears shed with guilt, regret, and longing mixed together would have no taste.
It's something really profound and artistic,
a pretty cool piece of writing, right? ㅋ
Honestly, it's so unfair.

messages.ko: 내가 초딩서부터 시랑 소설 계속 쓰던 노트들
messages.en: I want to show you the notebooks where I've been writing poems and novels since elementary school,
but...
I'll hold back.
It's embarrassing.
Out of everything I've written,
the one I'm most satisfied with, and the most complete,
is a mystery novel.

messages.ko: 주인공이 한 오피스텔로 들어가게 되면서 일어나는
messages.en: It's about a main character who moves into an officetel,
and the relationships that develop with the neighbors.
That's the part I find interesting.
One of the things on my bucket list is
to seriously study writing,
and publish a book of my own.
I've already crossed bungee jumping off my bucket list.
But next, I want to publish it without anyone knowing it's me,
as an unknown author,
with that kind of mysterious feeling.
But what if literally nobody cares...? ㅠ
Then I'll just hand out a few copies to the people around me...
Then later I'll probably reveal that it was me. ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 사실 나야!!! 내가 쓴거라고!!! 제발 읽어봐!!!
messages.en: "It was me!!! I wrote it!!! Please read it!!!"
ㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Life is fun.
I'll write an incredibly profound book,
brainwash everyone with it,
so that after finishing it, everyone ends up believing in the Church of Hayeon.
I'll create a world like that!!!
Mwahahaha!!!!!!!
You probably didn't know,
but if there were a Church of Hayeon,
would you believe in it?
Do you believe in Ha?
Mwahaha.
If you believe in Hayeon,

messages.ko: 눈이 개안하고 하연을 닮아져 귀여워지며! 모든일이 잘 풀릴것입니다
messages.en: your eyes will be opened, you'll become as cute as Hayeon, and everything in your life will go well!
ㅎㅎㅎㅎ
Recently, at the salon,
I joked, "Teacher, there's a ghost here."
I was just teasing them,
but the stylist actually believed me.
"What does it look like...?"
"How old is it...?"
They kept asking me that. ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
So I said,
"There's a little boy clinging onto you, teacher!!!"
Then the stylist went,
"Ah, tell him to go away!!!! ㅠㅠㅠ"
"Tell him to let go!! ㅠㅠㅠㅠ"
They actually said that.
Were they just playing along, or were they serious?
So I asked too,
after teasing them for a bit,
"Teacher... you didn't actually believe me, right?"
I asked,
and they replied, "What!!! It wasn't real!!!!??"
That's what they said.
It was so funny.

messages.ko: 아니 폰 꺼져서 바로 충전하고 왔어
messages.en: Anyway, my phone died, so I went to charge it right away.
That was quick, right?
It's at 1% now.
Anyway,
those were today's stories.

messages.ko: 하연아, 이제 이모티콘도 보낼 수 있는 거 알아?
messages.en: Hayeon, did you know you can send stickers now?
Why did they make mine so ugly?
That's what they gave me.
What is this?
It's so creepy.
Wait... Dahyun unnie drew this...?
She has profound artistic sense, just like me...
Whoa, Joobin is so cute.
She suddenly messaged me because she caught my scent.
So cute. ㅠㅠㅠ
I changed my perfume, you know.
Right now,
I think it's Kilian Woman in Gold.
This one has a slightly
more mature scent.

messages.ko: 전에는 더 중성적이고 코튼 그런거 썼징
messages.en: Before, I used more gender-neutral, cotton-like fragrances.

messages.ko: 근데 나이가 들수록 찾는 향도 달라지고 그래??
messages.en: Do the kinds of scents you like change as you get older?
Yeah, they actually do.
When I was younger, I liked fruity scents and fabric softener smells.
Those were my favorites.
Then I gradually started liking cotton powder scents.
Now I like slightly floral powder scents.
That's the kind of fragrance I like now.

messages.ko: 하연이가 싫어하는 향은 어떤거야?? 이게 더 궁금해 사실
messages.en: What kind of scents do you dislike? I'm actually more curious about that.
The ones I don't like are...

messages.ko: 아빠 스킨냄새 같은거랑 진한 우드 이런거
messages.en: things like my dad's aftershave or really strong woody fragrances.
I don't think I like sharp or overpowering scents.
I prefer natural, subtle fragrances.
They said this bunny is supposed to be Jeong Hayeon.
Dahyun unnie made it? ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
It should be called the 'Jingle Jingle Bell Bunny.'
Something like that would fit better!!!
Hahaha.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I should go take a shower now.

messages.ko: 밖에 공기가 완전 물을 머금고 있던데
messages.en: The air outside is completely full of moisture.
It's so humid.
I've got the dehumidifier running.
You should take a nice cool shower too, Y/n.
I'm heading off now.
Haranghae 😙😙
